inlines.v: INTOL'ERANT, adjective [Latin in and tolero, to endure.] 1. Not enduring; not able to endure. The powers of the human body being limited and intolerant of excesses. 2. Not enduring difference of opinion or worship; refusing to tolerate others in the enjoyment of their opinions, rights and worship. INTOL'ERANT, noun One who does not favor toleration.
